=== var-in-message
--- main
!$user = "Alice"
$user -> Bob : hi
=== var-conditional-keeps
--- main
!$color = "red"
!$color ?= "blue"
A : $color
=== var-conditional-sets
--- main
!$color ?= "blue"
A : $color
=== var-conditional-spaces
--- main
!$color = "red"
!$color   ?=   "blue"
!$other?="green"
A : $color $other
=== var-without-dollar
--- main
!x = 5
!y = x + 1
A : x y $x
=== var-reassign
--- main
!$a = 1
!$a = $a + 1
!$a = $a * 10
A : $a
=== var-concat-adjacent
--- main
!$a = "X"
A : $a$a $aY Y$a $a_b
=== var-adjacent-letters
--- main
!$ab = 1
!$a = 2
A : $ab $a $abc x$a
=== var-hash-concat
--- main
!$a = "X"
!b = "Y"
A : $a##suffix pre##$a b##c c##b ##b##
=== var-local-at-top
--- main
!local $x = 1
A : $x
=== var-global-at-top
--- main
!global $x = 1
A : $x
=== var-named-local
--- main
!$local = 5
!local = 6
A : $local local
=== var-local-in-function
--- main
!$x = "global"
!function $f()
!local $x = "local"
!return $x
!endfunction
A : $f() $x
=== var-global-in-function
--- main
!function $f()
!global $y = "set in f"
!return 1
!endfunction
!$z = $f()
A : $y
=== var-function-creates-local
--- main
!function $f()
!$tmp = "inside"
!return $tmp
!endfunction
A : $f() $tmp
=== var-function-modifies-global
--- main
!$g = 1
!function $f()
!$g = 2
!return $g
!endfunction
A : $f() $g
=== var-argument-shadows-global
--- main
!$a = "global"
!function $f($a)
!$a = "changed"
!return $a
!endfunction
A : $f("arg") $a
=== var-undef
--- main
!$a = 1
!undef $a
A : $a
=== var-undef-missing
--- main
!undef $nothing
A : ok
=== var-case-sensitive
--- main
!$A = 1
!$a = 2
A : $A $a
=== var-uppercase-directive
--- main
!$X = 1
!LOCAL $Y = 2
A : $X
=== var-emoji-name
--- main
!$x😀 = 1
A : $x😀
=== var-unicode-name
--- main
!$café = "coffee"
!$имя = "name"
A : $café $имя
=== var-digit-start
--- main
!$1a = 5
A : $1a
=== var-underscore
--- main
!$_a_ = 5
!_b = 6
A : $_a_ _b
=== var-value-with-newline-escape
--- main
!$a = "line1\nline2"
A : $a
=== var-in-quotes
--- main
!$a = "X"
A : "$a" '$a'
=== var-backslash-n-before
--- main
!$name = "X"
A : a\n$name\nname
=== var-define-from-cli
--- define: FOO=bar
--- define: $NUM=42
--- main
A : FOO $NUM
=== var-define-from-cli-ifdef
--- define: FOO=bar
--- main
!ifdef FOO
A : yes
!endif
=== var-trailing-spaces-value
--- main
!$a = "x"   
A : [$a]
=== var-indented
--- main
    !$a = 1
	!$b = 2
A : $a $b
=== var-space-after-bang
--- main
! $a = 1
!  local $b = 2
A : $a
=== var-scope-then-name
--- main
!local$a = 1
A : $a
